title: Mirabel and the Parish
author: Noor Quintana
blurb: Quentin Zhou, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the statute expires.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
